core_obligations: The author extracts a low-cost single-coordinate algorithm from a product-input query tree by controlling posterior XOR bias and finding many informative coordinates, while separately tracking distributional abort and error probabilities. The complete conversion back to expected randomized query cost and all original bounded-error conventions are retained. The total-function amplification example and restatements are not separately counted.
